items.exampleEn: She squandered a fortune on parties and fancy clothes.
items.exampleZh: 她把一大筆錢揮霍在派對和華麗的衣服上。

items.exampleEn: Who owns the old house is still contested in court.
items.exampleZh: 那棟老房子歸誰所有，在法庭上仍有爭議。

items.exampleEn: The palace is famous for its extravagance.
We gave up the trip because of the prohibitive price of flights.
items.exampleZh: 因為機票貴得令人卻步，我們放棄了這趟旅行。
items.glossZh: （價格）高得令人卻步的；禁止的

items.exampleEn: Houses in the city center are prohibitively expensive.
items.exampleZh: 市中心的房子貴到讓人買不起。

items.exampleEn: The bank charged her a fee for the overdraft.
items.exampleZh: 銀行因為她透支，向她收了一筆費用。

items.exampleEn: Buses are a cost-effective way to move many people.
items.exampleZh: 公車是運送大量乘客的划算方式。

items.sentenceEn: Don't squander your time on things that don't matter.
items.sentenceZh: 別把時間浪費在不重要的事情上。

items.audioEn: I used my overdraft to pay the rent this month.
items.audioZh: 這個月我用透支付了房租。
items.questionZh: 說話者這個月怎麼付房租？
options: With money from a new job

items.sentenceEn: Their wedding was a day of great extravagance.
items.sentenceZh: 他們的婚禮那天極盡奢華。

items.sentenceEn: It was a closely contested race until the last lap.
items.sentenceZh: 那是一場直到最後一圈都競爭激烈的比賽。

items.stemEn: She paid back her ____ as soon as her salary arrived.
items.stemZh: 她一領到薪水，就把透支的錢還清了。

items.stemEn: The team ____ a two-goal lead in the last ten minutes.
items.stemZh: 那支球隊在最後十分鐘白白浪費了兩球的領先。

items.passageEn: When the Kelton Sports Club planned a new club building, the cost of building an indoor pool turned out to be prohibitive. Some members accused the club's board of extravagance and said it had squandered money on an expensive design. The plan became so contested that one members' meeting lasted more than four hours. In the end, the board chose a more cost-effective idea: an outdoor pool that would be much cheaper to build. Heating it in winter would be prohibitively expensive, so it will open only from May to October.
items.passageZh: Kelton 運動俱樂部計畫興建新會館時，發現蓋室內游泳池的費用高得令人卻步。有些會員指責俱樂部的董事會奢侈浪費，說它把錢揮霍在昂貴的設計上。這項計畫爭議太大，有一場會員大會開了四個多小時。最後，董事會選擇了更划算的方案：一座造價便宜許多的戶外游泳池。由於冬天幫泳池加溫的費用高到難以負擔，泳池只會在五月到十月開放。

questions.questionZh: 最後董事會選擇了什麼方案？
options: 請居民自己出錢蓋泳池
照原計畫蓋室內游泳池
把運動中心蓋得更大一點

questions.questionZh: 泳池為什麼冬天不開放？
options: 冬天沒人想在戶外游泳

items.promptZh: 對小公司來說，用網路開會比較划算。
referenceEn: For small companies, online meetings are more cost-effective.
Holding meetings online is more cost-effective for small companies.
rubricZh: cost-effective 是形容詞，表示「划算的、有成本效益的」（例如 more cost-effective 等）
「用網路開會」可寫，例如 online meetings、holding meetings online 等

items.promptZh: 為寵物辦生日派對，在很多人眼中是一種奢侈。
referenceEn: In many people's eyes, throwing a birthday party for a pet is an extravagance.
Many people see a birthday party for a pet as an extravagance.
rubricZh: 「一種奢侈」用 an extravagance（例如 is an extravagance 等）
「在很多人眼中」可寫，例如 in many people's eyes、many people see…as 等
「辦生日派對」可寫，例如 throwing a birthday party、having a birthday party 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正："turned out to be prohibitive" 譯「高得驚人」漏了 prohibitive 的核心「高到無法負擔／令人卻步」（後文才因此改案）；建議「高得令人卻步」或「高到負擔不起」。
執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B：prohibitively 卡干擾項是單一詞，正解以「、」並列，格式洩題
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 干擾項改成「稍微地、有一點地」等同格式

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B 疑似 9：聽選正解是唯一 Using 開頭的選項且照抄音檔
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 正解改 With a bank overdraft，與干擾項同為 With 開頭

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B 疑似 10：閱讀寫鎮議會爭議，屬地方政治
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改成運動俱樂部董事會；地名 Riverside（一般單字組成）一併改為 Kelton

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：mcq "He ____ all his savings on a boat he never used." 與單字卡 "She squandered a fortune on parties and fancy clothes." 句型相同（S squandered 一筆錢 on 奢侈品）、情境相同（把錢揮霍在奢侈品），只換了主詞，未達「三項至少換兩項」（§11-4）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 題幹改 The team ____ a two-goal lead in the last ten minutes.（主詞、情境、句型都換）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B 疑似 8：三個干擾項都是 -ation 名詞，正解是唯一形態不同的選項
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 換掉兩個，改 salvation、legacy（u22），代入後不通

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：cost-effective 是形容詞，表示「划算的、有成本效益的」（例如 more cost-effective 等）／「用網路開會」可寫，例如 online meetings、holding meetings online 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（extravagance）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u26-l01-q16；目標字沿用 extravagance
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「為寵物辦生日派對，在很多人眼中是一種奢侈。」、hintWords ["extravagance"]、referenceEn ["In many people's eyes, throwing a birthday party for a pet is an extravagance.","Many people see a birthday party for a pet as an extravagance."]、rubricZh ["「一種奢侈」用 an extravagance（例如 is an extravagance 等）","「在很多人眼中」可寫，例如 in many people's eyes、many people see…as 等","「辦生日派對」可寫，例如 throwing a birthday party、having a birthday party 等"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 extravagance 造一個句子，說說一件你覺得很奢侈的事。」、referenceEn ["For me, taking a taxi to school is an extravagance.","My one extravagance is buying fresh flowers every week."]）
